title: Polycarp's Picture Gallery
statementMd:
Polycarp loves not only to take pictures, but also to show his photos to friends. On his personal website he has recently installed a widget that can display $*n*$ photos with the scroll option. At each moment of time the widget displays exactly one photograph with the option showing the previous/next one. From the first photo, you can switch to the second one or to the $*n*$-th one, from the second photo you can switch to the third one or to the first one, etc. Thus, navigation is performed in a cycle.

Polycarp's collection consists of $*m*$ photo albums, the $*i*$-th album contains $*a*_{*i*}$ photos. Polycarp wants to choose $*n*$ photos and put them on a new widget. To make watching the photos interesting to the visitors, he is going to post pictures so that no two photos from one album were neighboring (each photo will have exactly two neighbors, the first photo's neighbors are the second and the $*n*$-th one).

Help Polycarp compile a photo gallery. Select $*n*$ photos from his collection and put them in such order that no two photos from one album went one after the other.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 40$), where $*n*$ is the number of photos on the widget, and $*m*$ is the number of albums. The second line contains $*m*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number of photos in the $*i*$-th album.

## Output

Print the single number `-1` if there is no solution. Otherwise, print $*n*$ numbers $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$, where $*t*_{*i*}$ represents the number of the album of the $*i*$-th picture in the widget. The albums are numbered from 1 in the order of their appearance in the input. If there are several solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 不仅喜欢拍照，还喜欢向朋友展示自己的照片。他最近在个人网站上安装了一个可以通过滚动选项显示 $*n*$ 张照片的小组件。在任意时刻，小组件恰好显示一张照片，并提供查看上一张/下一张照片的选项。从第一张照片可以切换到第二张或第 $*n*$ 张，从第二张照片可以切换到第三张或第一张，依此类推。因此，导航是循环进行的。

Polycarp 的照片收藏由 $*m*$ 个相册组成，第 $*i*$ 个相册包含 $*a*_{*i*}$ 张照片。Polycarp 想要选择 $*n*$ 张照片，并将它们放入一个新的小组件中。为了让访客观看照片时更有趣，他打算安排照片，使得同一个相册中的任意两张照片都不会相邻（每张照片恰好有两个相邻照片，第一张照片的相邻照片是第二张和第 $*n*$ 张）。

请帮助 Polycarp 制作照片画廊。从他的收藏中选择 $*n*$ 张照片，并按照某种顺序排列，使得同一个相册中的任意两张照片都不会相邻。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 40$），其中 $*n*$ 是小组件中照片的数量，$*m*$ 是相册的数量。第二行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个相册中的照片数量。

## 输出格式

如果不存在解，输出一个数字 `-1`。否则，输出 $*n*$ 个数字 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*$，其中 $*t*_{*i*}$ 表示小组件中第 $*i*$ 张照片所属的相册编号。相册按照它们在输入中的出现顺序从 1 开始编号。如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。
